events.title: 월주 산음에서 태어나다
events.description: 남송 월주 산음현에서 태어났다. 지금의 저장성 사오싱이다. 대대로 책을 모아 온 강남의 명문가 출신이었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Shanyin county, Yuezhou, in the Southern Song—present-day Shaoxing, Zhejiang. His family was a well-known Jiangnan lineage of book collectors.

events.title: 당완과 혼인했다 갈라서다
events.title_en: He married Tang Wan, then was forced to part from her
events.description: 외사촌 당완과 혼인해 서로를 아꼈으나 어머니의 뜻에 밀려 갈라서고 말았다.
events.description_en: He married his cousin Tang Wan and the two were devoted to each other, but at his mother's insistence they were forced to separate.

events.title: 심원에서 당완과 우연히 마주쳐 '채두봉'을 쓰다
events.title_en: He chanced upon Tang Wan at Shen Garden and wrote Chaitou Feng
events.description: 산음 심원에서 재혼한 당완과 우연히 마주쳤다. 복받치는 마음을 담아 담벼락에 사 '채두봉'을 적었다.
events.description_en: He unexpectedly encountered the now-remarried Tang Wan at Shen Garden in Shanyin. Overcome with feeling, he inscribed the lyric poem Chaitou Feng on the garden wall.

events.title: 과거에서 수석을 하고도 진회에게 밀려나다
events.title_en: He topped the examination, only to be blocked by Qin Hui
events.description: 쇄청시에서 수석을 차지했는데 재상 진회의 손자가 차석이었다. 진회가 노해 이듬해 예부시에서도 그를 떨어뜨리게 했다.
events.description_en: He placed first in the locked-hall examination, while Chancellor Qin Hui's grandson placed second. Furious, Qin Hui saw to it that he was failed again the following year at the Ministry of Rites examination.

events.title: 효종이 즉위하며 진사 자격을 받고 벼슬길에 나서다
events.title_en: He was granted jinshi status and entered office under Emperor Xiaozong
events.description: 효종이 즉위하며 진사 출신 자격을 내려 비로소 벼슬길이 열렸다. 이후로도 금과의 항전을 주장하다 화친파에게 거듭 밀려났다.
events.description_en: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, he was granted jinshi status and his career finally opened up. He went on to be repeatedly sidelined by the peace faction for insisting on resisting the Jin.

events.title: 왕염의 막부에 들어가 항전 최전선에 서다
events.title_en: He joined Wang Yan's staff at the front lines of resistance
events.description: 사천선무사 왕염의 초빙으로 남정 막부에 들어가 종군했다. 금의 실지를 되찾자는 그의 오랜 주장이 실행에 옮겨지는 순간이었다.
events.description_en: At the invitation of Wang Yan, Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, he joined the military staff at Nanzheng. It was the closest his long-held call to reclaim lost territory from the Jin ever came to action.

events.title: 막부가 해체되며 촉 땅 깊이 들어가다
events.title_en: As the staff disbanded, he moved deep into Shu
events.description: 왕염의 막부가 해체되자 명을 받고 촉 땅 깊숙이 들어가 여러 임지를 옮겨 다녔다.
events.description_en: When Wang Yan's staff was disbanded, he was ordered deeper into the Shu region and moved through a series of postings there.

events.title: 예순여덟에 심원을 다시 찾다
events.title_en: At sixty-eight he revisited Shen Garden
events.description: 마흔 해 전 담벼락에 시를 적었던 심원을 다시 찾아 짧은 시를 또 한 편 남겼다.
events.description_en: He returned to Shen Garden, where he had inscribed a poem on the wall forty years before, and left behind one more short verse.

events.title: 두 황제의 실록 편찬을 맡다
events.title_en: He was tasked with compiling the veritable records of two emperors
events.description: 영종의 부름을 받고 도성으로 가 효종과 광종 두 황제의 실록 편찬을 맡았다. 일을 마친 뒤로는 산음에 묻혀 지냈다.
events.description_en: Summoned to the capital by Emperor Ningzong, he took charge of compiling the veritable records of emperors Xiaozong and Guangzong. Once the work was done, he lived out his years in seclusion at Shanyin.

events.title: '시아'를 남기고 여든다섯에 죽다
events.title_en: He died at eighty-five, leaving behind Shi Er
events.description: 산음에서 여든다섯에 죽었다. 마지막 시 '시아'에서 아들에게, 나라가 중원을 되찾는 날 제사상에서 그 소식을 잊지 말고 알려 달라고 당부했다.
events.description_en: He died at Shanyin at eighty-five. In his final poem, Shi Er, he asked his son not to forget to tell him at the ancestral rites, the day the north was finally reclaimed.
